'''1997 Dantooine Regionals (Tulsa)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Dantooine region (Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Dantooine)
* '''Date:''' 20 September 1997
* '''Site:''' DefCon, Tulsa, Oklahoma
